where: i1-station-curves-linear: js/stations/curves.js, TAKEAWAY.circle, set with takeawayP.textContent (visible body copy on the Circle preset)

The design copy deck 2.10 has the same braces, so this is a copy bug in the design too.

where: i1-station-curves-linear: js/stations/linear.js, w-plane marks layer: dotWords 'close' label next to the fixed-point label FIXED_LABEL {dx: 8, dy: 28}. Seen on a phone at #problem-2-1-3 and #problem-P3, stage 3, the default state.
problem: [minor] On a phone, f(0) and f(1) are 29.8 px apart, under the 36 px limit, so the single label 'f(0), f(1)' is drawn at f(0). The fixed point (1, -1) sits right beside it and its 'p' label lands on top of 'f(1)'. That is an overprint on the first screen of the main 2.1.3 problem. It appeared with the round-2 merged label, and the script only asserts non-overlap for the curves handle words, so nothing caught it.
fix: When the merged label is used, move or drop the fixed-point label. For example give the merged label a leftward offset, or put 'p' above its dot. Add a w-plane label-overlap assertion at phone width for 2.1.3, P3 and P4.

where: i1-station-curves-linear: js/stations/linear.js phone CSS '#station-linear .ln-caption{font-size:.84rem;min-height:3.1em}' (design deviation, fix round 2 finding 5)
problem: [minor] I accept the deviation, because it stops the sticky caption from changing height on a b drag at 390 px, which I measured as 0.00 px of plane and page movement. Two caveats. First, design 2.10 says to shorten the string 'never the font', and 8.5 says body copy keeps the shell size, so the smaller font breaks that rule. Second, at 375, 360 and 340 px the longest captions, with long decimals in b, still wrap to a third line. The bar then changes height and only the scroll keeper hides it. That is a common phone width (iPhone SE and mini), and I could not test the keeper on Safari.
fix: Shorten the done caption when b has decimals, for example 'Stage 3 of 3 done: slid by b. This is f(z) = az + b.', since b is already in the readout. Or reserve three lines below 24rem, and reword design 2.10 so the exception is written down.

where: i1-station-curves-linear: curves orientation label (placeOrientLabel and the order-140 layer), desktop and phone
problem: [minor] The label is clear of the handle words and the curve, but it is not always next to its arrow. On the forward 3-unit square on desktop the arrow is on the left side and the label sits in the middle, about 70 px away. On the phone circle (forward and reversed) the tip is beside the '2' tick. The last change made the cursor ring a soft cost of 6, so the label or arrow can now pass over the ring while Play runs, and I saw this with the addresses overlay at t = 0.4 on a phone. Costs of 14 to 17 are accepted for the square. This is cosmetic and below the stated threshold of 40.
fix: Optional. Prefer a second line of text beside the arrow, or tighten the soft costs so the label stays within about 40 px of the tip. Keep the ring as a small cost.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: js/stations/staircase.js teleport() (design 5.2 D and I); presets #staircase-preset-131, -neg, -1i
problem: [minor] Clicking a preset chip while the Walk is running does not stop the Walk. The dot jumps to the preset for one frame, then the next tick overwrites it and the walk continues on its old circle. The preset appears to do nothing. The lap count is also wrong. With Start over, Walk, a click on -2 after 0.8 s, and waiting for the end, the readout ended at laps = 2 for a single lap. The cause is that teleport() re-begins the tracker at the preset's angle while the walk's moveTo keeps counting from the old phi. The design omitted a stop here, so this is a design gap that the build copied faithfully.
fix: Call stopWalk(false) at the top of teleport(), which also covers the three preset chips. Optionally also stop the Walk in the Turn handler's neighbours, but the Turn handler already does.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: js/stations/staircase.js STYLE, .stair-col
problem: [minor] At viewport widths of 330 px and below the staircase page scrolls horizontally by about 12 px (scrollWidth 332 at 320). The grid column `.stair-col` has an implicit auto track whose min-content is forced by the explainer panel. Widths of 340 px and above, including the design's 390 px phone target, are fine. The powers page and other stations are fine at 320 px.
fix: Add `grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);` to `.stair-col`. I verified in the browser that this brings scrollWidth back to 320 at 320 px.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: powers spiral plane, default state (recorded deviation D2, accepted)
problem: [minor] With the ghost arc de-emphasised, the faint n·θ = 5π/3 arc is a thin 0.35-alpha ring of about 26 px radius, next to the ruler's own ring 0 (radius about 43 px) and the hollow '1' dot. It reads as one more ring of the ruler rather than as a 300° counterclockwise winding that ends on the same ray as the solid Arg arc. Its label is muted grey. The 'one direction, two names' idea is carried mainly by the text label.
fix: Draw the ghost arc dashed, or in a visibly different weight or alpha, or put its label in --polar. Alternatively give the ghost ring a radius that cannot be confused with a ruler ring.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: powers spiral plane, edge states (drawSpiral ring and arc labels)
problem:
[minor] Label collisions in edge states.
- Flat ruler (|z| = 1): the '|z| = 1' label sits on dot 9 and the ring.
- |z| < 1 with n = 12: the small ring labels (0.0..) overlap dots 10 to 12 and their labels near the origin, and the 'Re' axis label touches the hollow '1'.
- Large z, n = 12: 'n·θ = 9π' is partly hidden by the '1' marker.
The plane's axis tick marks also remain on the log-ruler plane. They imply a linear scale that does not exist there, because tickLabels is false but the ticks still draw.
fix: Run the ring labels and the |z| = 1 label through pickSpot against the dot boxes, or drop ring labels that collide. Consider axes: false, or ticks off, on #powers-spiral.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: staircase plane canvas, z = 0 state and the r label

On the sum plane, 'z₁z₂ is off the plane (|z₁z₂| = 12.5)' is struck through by the real axis. These are cosmetic.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: js/stations/powers.js, the snap passed to planeL.addPoint (snapNice(p, 4 / scale)); the staircase handles use the same pattern
problem: [minor] The magnet tolerance is 4 px, which is larger than the 0.1 keyboard step on a narrow plane. At phone width the powers plane is 35.8 px/unit, so the tolerance is about 0.11 units. Plain ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right from the default z = √3 + i snap straight back and never move the point (I measured moved=false in all four directions). Shift+Arrow (1.0 step) does escape. On desktop (48 px/unit) the arrows work. This only affects keyboard-only use of the powers plane at about 390 px width.
fix: Cap the tolerance below the key step, for example tol = Math.min(4 / view.scale, 0.045), or stop snapping when the move is smaller than the key step.

where: i1-station-staircase-powers: powers right plane (#powers-spiral) and caption
